basic_details.job_title: DIAT Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for Assistant, Lab Technician Posts
basic_details.short_information: Defence Institute of Advanced Technology (DIAT), Pune, will hold a walk-in interview on 30 October 2026 at 1100 Hrs. The venue is DIAT, Girinagar, Near Khadakwasla Dam, Pune-411025. DIAT will engage 4 Graduate / Diploma Apprentices for one year of apprenticeship training: 3 Assistant (General Administration) and 1 Lab Technician. The monthly consolidated stipend is ₹12,300/- (Including 50% DBT). The training comes under the Apprentices Act, 1961, under Advt. No. 02-2026/APPRENTICESHIP/DIAT.

When reserved-category candidates are not available, the reserved training places may be filled by persons outside the reserved category.

DIAT, Girinagar, Near Khadakwasla Dam, Pune-411025

Citizens of India with the qualification for the post, who passed the qualifying examination not more than 4 years before the interview date

content_sections.heading: About DIAT
content_sections.text: Defence Institute of Advanced Technology (DIAT) is a Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956. It works under the aegis of the Department of Defence Research & Development, Ministry of Defence, Govt. of India, and is located at Girinagar, Pune - 411 025. The Board of Apprenticeship Training, Western Region (BOAT-WR) governs this apprenticeship training.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Both posts carry the same monthly consolidated stipend of ₹12,300/- (Including 50% DBT), which the notice lists for Graduate Apprentices. The interview is open to any Citizen of India with a graduate (Sci / Engg) / Diploma (Engg) Degree from a recognized University. This applies to the Graduate / Diploma trainee Apprentice. No more than 4 years may pass between the passing date of the qualifying degree examination and the date of the interview. Candidates must register on the NATS 2.0 (National Apprenticeship Training Scheme) web portal, https://nats.education.gov.in/index.php. Their bank account must be seeded with Aadhar. The minimum age is 18 Years and the maximum age is 27 Years. For Reserved Categories and Persons with Disability [PWD], the upper age limit is as per Govt. of India Rules in vogue. The notice does not mention a date on which age is counted. For the post table's reservation column, the notice says: "As per Govt. of India norms - candidates from all category can apply." Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD/EWS applies as per the provisions of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Central Apprenticeship Rules, Apprentices Act 1961, Apprenticeship Rules, 1992, and Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules, 2015 & 2019. When reserved-category candidates are not available, the reserved training places may be filled by persons outside the reserved category. Graduate Apprentices get a monthly consolidated stipend of ₹12,300/- (Including 50% DBT). The stipend may be revised if the Govt of India increases it under the relevant Act / Rules. Apprentices may use the free primary / OPD medical facility at the MI Room, DIAT (only for self) in an emergency during training. DIAT will not provide accommodation or a travel allowance/facility. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification: Any Engg / Sc Graduate / Diploma in Engg

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: 10th / 12th Passing certificate & mark sheet Qualifying degree passing certificate & mark sheet Date of Birth certificate/birth date proof Caste certificate, if applicable Passport size photographs (2 nos.) PAN card Aadhar card Photo copy of the Bank passbook front page or cancelled cheque The application form asks for these details: Full name in block capitals Date of birth / age Category (Gen/SC/ST/OBC(NCL only)/ESM/PWD) Permanent and present (mailing) address, each with PIN code PAN No, Mobile No, Aadhaar Card No and E-mail id Area of specialization/interest Educational qualifications, highest first: board/university, year of passing, marks and percentage Experience: grade/designation, period and establishment The form ends with a declaration that the information is true. Candidates sign it and add the place and date.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report at DIAT, Girinagar, Near Khadakwasla Dam, Pune-411025 at 1100 Hrs on 30 October 2026. DIAT will scrutinise their original documents. Graduate or diploma trainee apprentices will be provisionally selected based on their performance in the test / interview. DIAT will display the list of these candidates on the institute website. Selection is provisional and depends on later verification of certificates. A candidate who does not meet the eligibility norms, or who gave incorrect or false information, will have the candidature cancelled. This can happen at any stage of the engagement or afterwards. If a dispute or ambiguity arises in the selection process, the Institute's decision is final.

faq.question: Q1. When is the DIAT walk-in interview for apprentices in 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 30 October 2026 at 1100 Hrs.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the DIAT walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: The interview is at DIAT, Girinagar, Near Khadakwasla Dam, Pune-411025.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are in DIAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 04 vacancies: 03 for Assistant (General Administration) and 01 for Lab Technician.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for the DIAT apprentice posts?
faq.answer: Assistant (General Administration) needs "Any Graduate". Lab Technician needs "Any Engg / Sc Graduate / Diploma in Engg". The qualifying examination must have been passed not more than 4 years before the interview date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the DIAT apprenticeship?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 Years and the maximum is 27 Years. For Reserved Categories and PWD candidates, the upper age limit is as per Govt. of India Rules in vogue.

faq.question: Q6. What stipend does a DIAT Graduate Apprentice get?
faq.answer: Graduate Apprentices get a monthly consolidated stipend of ₹12,300/- (Including 50% DBT). The stipend may be revised if the Govt of India increases it under the relevant Act / Rules.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the DIAT walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring the filled application form with a set of xerox copies. Also bring originals and attested copies of your 10th / 12th and degree certificates and mark sheets, date of birth proof, caste certificate (if applicable), PAN card and Aadhar card. Add 2 passport size photographs and a copy of the bank passbook front page or a cancelled cheque.

faq.question: Q8. How will DIAT select the apprentices?
faq.answer: Candidates are provisionally selected based on their performance in the test / interview, subject to verification of certificates. The list is displayed on the institute website.

faq.question: Q9. Is NATS registration required for the DIAT apprenticeship?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must register on the NATS 2.0 portal (https://nats.education.gov.in/index.php), and their bank account must be seeded with Aadhar.

faq.question: Q10. Is the DIAT apprenticeship a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a One Year apprenticeship training, and DIAT has no obligation to employ apprentices after their training ends. No accommodation or travel allowance is provided.
